description: List preprints that appeared as journal articles within a journal publication-date interval, each with its journal DOI, journal name, publication date, and preprint metadata — the same record biorxiv_get_published_version returns for one DOI. The dates filter on journal publication, not preprint posting, so most rows were posted months or years earlier; use biorxiv_list_recent for preprints posted in an interval. Returns `limit` publications per server (default 25, up to 100 — the page api.biorxiv.org serves; a larger limit returns 100 and says so). Continue at the `nextCursor` a page returns rather than stepping `cursor` by a fixed amount; `limit: 100` walks an interval in the fewest calls. When server="both" (default), per-server pagination state is returned separately, since one cursor can be past the end of one server and inside the other — to continue a single server, pass its `nextCursor` with `server` set to that server. One server failing under server="both" does not abort the call: the other server's page is still returned and the failed one is named in `failed[]`. Every attempted server failing raises a retryable upstream_unavailable (or rate_limited) error rather than an empty page. Abstracts are omitted by default to keep the page small — pass include_abstract: true for the whole page. Every preprintDoi, 10.1101/ and 10.64898/ alike, is accepted by biorxiv_get_preprint and the other DOI tools.

cursor.description: Integer row offset, applied to each queried server. Defaults to 0 (first page). To continue, pass the nextCursor the previous page returned for that server — it advances by the rows actually served.

end_date.description: End of the journal publication-date interval (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

include_abstract.description: Include each preprint's abstract. Defaults to false: abstracts make up about three quarters of a page, and every other field is returned either way.

limit.description: Rows to return per queried server, starting at cursor. Defaults to 25. Up to 100, the page api.biorxiv.org serves: a larger value returns 100 rows per server and says so in the notice. limit: 100 walks an interval in the fewest calls.

server.description: Preprint server to list. "both" lists bioRxiv and medRxiv in parallel; their rows do not overlap.

start_date.description: Start of the journal publication-date interval (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: biorxiv_list_published_versions

cap.description: Most publications this page can hold: rows per server (limit, or 100 when limit asked for more) times the servers queried. Set with truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: start_date or end_date is not a real calendar date (2024-02-30, 2024-13-01), or end_date is before start_date. `upstream_unavailable`: Every attempted server failed against api.biorxiv.org, so no page was retrieved and an empty interval could not be established. `rate_limited`: Every attempted server failed and at least one was rejected with HTTP 429 by api.biorxiv.org. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: Servers that did not answer, so their rows are missing from "publications" and they have no "pagination" entry. Non-empty means this result set is partial — retry to include them. Only populated under server="both", and never holding every attempted server: when none answered, the call fails with upstream_unavailable or rate_limited instead. Distinct from an exhausted pagination entry, where the server answered.

items.description: A server that did not answer.

error.description: What went wrong on that server.

notice.description: Guidance on how to read this result set: which servers did not answer, a limit above the 100-row page, which cursors are past the end, which servers have rows past this page, and — when nothing came back — the interval and how to broaden it. All applicable qualifications are composed into one string.

pagination.description: Per-server pagination state. Advance each server independently.

biorxiv.description: bioRxiv pagination state. Present when bioRxiv was queried and answered.

cursor.description: Cursor (row offset) this page was requested at.

exhausted.description: True when the cursor is at or past bioRxiv's last row: no rows came back at a non-zero cursor. Lower the cursor to page bioRxiv.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, when rows remain on bioRxiv past this one: this page's cursor plus the rows it served. Pass it as cursor to continue, at any limit.

total.description: Journal publications on bioRxiv in the interval. Absent only when the entry is exhausted: bioRxiv reports no total for a cursor past its last row.

medrxiv.description: medRxiv pagination state. Present when medRxiv was queried and answered.

cursor.description: Cursor (row offset) this page was requested at.

exhausted.description: True when the cursor is at or past medRxiv's last row: no rows came back at a non-zero cursor. Lower the cursor to page medRxiv.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, when rows remain on medRxiv past this one: this page's cursor plus the rows it served. Pass it as cursor to continue, at any limit.

total.description: Journal publications on medRxiv in the interval. Absent only when the entry is exhausted: medRxiv reports no total for a cursor past its last row.

publications.description: Publications in the interval, in upstream order: bioRxiv rows first, then medRxiv rows.

items.description: One preprint and the journal article it became.

preprintAbstract.description: Preprint abstract. Present only when include_abstract is true.

preprintDate.description: Preprint posting date (YYYY-MM-DD) as this row records it — the first posting for most preprints. medRxiv lists some 10.64898/ preprints on two rows that differ in this date, and sometimes in title or authors; both rows are returned. Not derivable from the DOI.

preprintDoi.description: Preprint DOI — input to biorxiv_get_preprint and the other DOI tools.

publishedDate.description: Journal publication date (YYYY-MM-DD), within the requested interval.

server.description: Preprint server that listed this publication.

shown.description: Publications on this page, across every server queried. Set with truncated.

truncated.description: True when at least one server has rows past this page — continue at that server's nextCursor. Absent when every server queried is on its last page.

title: List Published Journal Versions
